The exact tables. Every page here except this one is generated from the tuimark binary itself (its --help and the catalogs behind tuimark agents), so it matches the runtime you install.

PageWhat it lists
CLIEvery command and flag, and the exit codes
Tags and attributesThe closed set of tags and the attributes each one takes, in version="1" and version="2" documents
CSS propertiesEvery TCSS property and its values
Key tokensThe names a <bind keys="…"> row accepts
Diagnostic codesEvery V…, L…, and B… code and when it is reported

The same information, in the compact form an agent reads, is one command away:

sh
tuimark agents

For how the pieces fit together, start with the guide: The .tui language, TCSS, Layout.
